description: Create an RGB color from red, green, and blue channels. Each channel is clamped to the inclusive range from 0 through 255.

inputs.name: red
inputs.description: Red channel value. Values outside 0 through 255 are clamped to the supported channel range.

inputs.name: green
inputs.description: Green channel value. Values outside 0 through 255 are clamped to the supported channel range.

inputs.name: blue
inputs.description: Blue channel value. Values outside 0 through 255 are clamped to the supported channel range.

outputs.name: color
outputs.description: Returns the RGB color built from the three clamped channels.

description: Parse a 3-digit or 6-digit hexadecimal RGB color. A leading # is accepted; invalid hexadecimal text or any other length fails before output.

inputs.name: hex_string
inputs.description: Three-digit or six-digit hexadecimal RGB text, optionally prefixed with #. Missing or null input uses #FFFFFF; invalid text or any other length fails before output.

description: Format an RGB color as a six-digit hexadecimal value. Missing or null color input uses white.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: RGB color to format. Missing or null input uses white.

outputs.name: hex_string
outputs.description: Returns the color as a six-digit hexadecimal string.

description: Read the red, green, and blue channels of an RGB color. Missing or null color input uses white.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: RGB color whose channels should be read. Missing or null input uses white.

outputs.name: red
outputs.description: Returns the red channel from 0 through 255.

outputs.name: green
outputs.description: Returns the green channel from 0 through 255.

outputs.name: blue
outputs.description: Returns the blue channel from 0 through 255.

description: Invert every RGB channel by replacing it with 255 minus its value. Missing or null color input uses white.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: RGB color to invert. Missing or null input uses white.

outputs.name: inverted_color
outputs.description: Returns the color with every channel inverted.

description: Brighten an RGB color by a finite normalized amount. Missing or null color uses white, missing or null amount uses 0.2, and the amount is clamped to 0 through 1. Non-finite amounts fail before output; channel results are truncated and capped at 255.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: RGB color to brighten. Missing or null input uses white.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: Finite normalized brightening amount from 0 through 1. Missing or null input uses 0.2; values are clamped, non-finite values fail before output, and channel results are truncated.

outputs.name: brightened_color
outputs.description: Returns the brightened color with channels capped at 255.

description: Darken an RGB color by a finite normalized amount. Missing or null color uses white, missing or null amount uses 0.2, and the amount is clamped to 0 through 1. Non-finite amounts fail before output; channel results are truncated and floored at 0.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: RGB color to darken. Missing or null input uses white.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.description: Finite normalized darkening amount from 0 through 1. Missing or null input uses 0.2; values are clamped, non-finite values fail before output, and channel results are truncated.

outputs.name: darkened_color
outputs.description: Returns the darkened color with channels floored at 0.

description: Blend two RGB colors by interpolating each channel with a finite ratio. Missing or null color1 uses white, color2 uses black, and missing or null ratio uses 0.5; ratio is clamped to 0 through 1, channels are truncated, and non-finite ratios fail before output.

inputs.name: color1
inputs.description: First RGB color to interpolate from. Missing or null input uses white.

inputs.name: color2
inputs.description: Second RGB color to interpolate toward. Missing or null input uses black.

inputs.name: ratio
inputs.description: Finite interpolation ratio from 0 through 1. Missing or null input uses 0.5; values are clamped, non-finite values fail before output, and channel results are truncated.

outputs.name: mixed_color
outputs.description: Returns the color produced by channel-by-channel interpolation.

description: Create a fresh nondeterministic random RGB color. Each execution chooses every channel independently from 0 through 255.

outputs.name: color
outputs.description: Returns a newly generated random RGB color.

description: Measure the Euclidean distance between two RGB colors. Missing or null color1 uses white and color2 uses black.

inputs.name: color1
inputs.description: First RGB color in the Euclidean distance calculation. Missing or null input uses white.

inputs.name: color2
inputs.description: Second RGB color in the Euclidean distance calculation. Missing or null input uses black.

outputs.name: distance
outputs.description: Returns the Euclidean distance between the two RGB colors.
